title: General Sir Richard Wilbraham
dates: (1811-1900)
---

Governor of the Royal Hospital, Netley

He married (1846) Eliza Frances Egerton and had one daughter, Katherine (Wilbraham) Baker-Wilbraham.

He was confirmed as an adult after instruction by Keble, and may have inspired the episode in The Young Stepmother.

His papers are in Cheshire Record Office.
